headline.zh: 安福路12年老店，自研拼配豆
headline.en: 12-year Anfu Road original with house blend

traits.zh: 招牌精品咖啡限时11元一杯
traits.en: Signature specialty coffee for ¥11, limited time

traits.zh: 采用自研拼配豆，豆源覆盖埃塞俄比亚、哥伦比亚、云南
traits.en: House-blended beans from Ethiopia, Colombia, and Yunnan

traits.zh: 北欧风大店，含半开放厨房与落地窗
traits.en: Spacious Nordic-style shop with open kitchen and floor-to-ceiling windows
Anfu Road store open until 10:30 PM

traits.zh: 2010年始于上海安福路，Wagas集团旗下
traits.en: Founded on Anfu Road in 2010, under Wagas Group

focus.zh: 有半开放厨房和固定座椅
focus.en: Has open kitchen and fixed seating

linger.zh: 空间宽敞，含露天位与HAY座椅
linger.en: Spacious with outdoor seating and HAY chairs

adventure.zh: 自研拼配豆但未提手冲或实验饮品
adventure.en: House blend but no mention of pour-over or experimental drinks
